inspiration: A spawner is one data record: population cap, respawn delay window, home radius, walking radius, team, and a list of entries each with its own cap and weight. This is the row 23 shape in data. Ref Distribution/Data/Spawns/shared/trammel/Reagents.json lines 9-16.

Weighted pick among non-full entries: Spawn() sums probability over entries that are neither full nor disabled, rolls 1..sum, walks the list subtracting weights and spawns the first hit. Ref Projects/UOContent/Engines/Spawners/BaseSpawner.cs lines 850-890 (867, 886).
Two-level cap: spawner-wide full check (BaseSpawner.cs line 292) plus per-entry full check (SpawnerEntry.cs line 162). A zone cap and a per-type cap in one rule.
Respawn rebuilds: Respawn() removes all spawns, spawns to the count, then calls DoTimer(); the source comment on that call is contradictory and was not resolved. Ref BaseSpawner.cs lines 406-415.
Spawn position: random attempts inside bounds first (phase 1, line 442, x drawn at line 457), spiral scan behind a flag (line 389). Later phases not read.
Walking radius falls back to home radius when unset. Ref BaseSpawner.cs line 302. Default delays five and ten minutes at lines 49-50.

briefs.label: Reagent grove
briefs.why: a dense patch of gatherable nodes makes a walk feel rewarding
briefs.keep: one spawner with a large population cap, a respawn window of about 11 to 23 minutes, and weighted entries
briefs.change: Recreate as a distinct original, never a copy: elemental shrine nodes on a 2 to 4 minute cadence, glowing rather than leafy

briefs.label: Leashed patrol spawner
briefs.why: a home radius and a wider walk radius give territory without hard walls
briefs.keep: home radius plus a walk radius that defaults to it
briefs.change: Recreate as a distinct original, never a copy: the leash is a per-zone data field with a wander ring instead of square bounds

briefs.label: Rare champion slot
briefs.why: an entry with its own cap and a low weight gives a rare encounter inside a normal spawner
briefs.keep: per-entry cap and weight inside the same spawner
briefs.change: Recreate as a distinct original, never a copy: a warning telegraph before it appears, with its own voice
